home.title: Out of the oven by eight
home.lede: A neighborhood bakery on Wilshire, opening July 2026.
body: Long ferments and laminated layers, like the best Paris bakeries. Cardamom and orange blossom, like home.
Louma is named for Milla's sister. A small place with a big idea: a bakery run well can be somewhere everyone belongs.
home.missionLine: Built so everyone at the counter belongs.
home.newsletterBody: One note when the doors open. Nothing else.

menu.title: What we bake
menu.lede: Baked through the morning and sold until it runs out. Prices and items are placeholders until we open.
menu.allergenNote: Our kitchen handles wheat, dairy, eggs, nuts, and sesame. We can't guarantee any item is free of them. Ask us and we'll tell you what's in it.

story.title: Named for Louma
story.lede: How a sister's name became a bakery on Wilshire.
body: Milla Ghandour started Louma with one belief: good bread and good work belong to everyone.
Many of the people who make Louma run have intellectual or developmental differences. Done right, that's a strength.

founder.name: Milla Ghandour
body: Milla grew up baking with her sister Louma. The bakery carries her name, and a promise about who it's for.
She spent years in professional kitchens before building one she'd want to work in: fair pay, and a door open to people most places overlook.

mission.title: The work, and who does it
mission.lede: Hiring people other places overlook is how this bakery is built.
body: We hire people who are often shut out of work, and train them to be great at it.
If you'd like to support that, you can give. Every dollar goes to training and wages.

values.title: Real jobs
values.body: Paid, skilled work with room to grow. Not busywork, not a photo op.

values.title: Designed to fit
values.body: We shape roles and training around how people actually learn and work.

values.title: High standards
values.body: Inclusion and excellence aren't a trade-off. The bread proves it every morning.

mission.donateBody: Every dollar goes straight to training and wages. No overhead, no middleman.

catering.title: Catering & wholesale
catering.lede: Bread and pastry for offices and events nearby.
body: Tell us the date and the headcount. We'll send back what we can do.

steps.title: Tell us
steps.body: Send the date and a rough idea. The form below is enough.

steps.title: We propose
steps.body: We reply within two business days with options and a quote.

steps.title: We bake
steps.body: Pickup on Wilshire or delivery nearby, fresh that morning.

careers.title: Work at Louma
careers.lede: We're hiring ahead of opening, in the kitchen and at the counter.
body: Most roles don't need bakery experience. Showing up and wanting to learn counts for more.
We hire people who are often shut out of work, and train them to be great at it. Tell us a little about yourself and we'll be in touch.

roles.title: Training Track
roles.body: A paid, supported path into baking and counter work. Start here if you've never been given the chance. No experience needed.

roles.title: Baker
roles.body: Shape and bake bread and pastry through the morning. Experience helps; attitude counts more.

roles.title: Counter & Service
roles.body: Run the register and keep the case full and the room warm.

roles.title: Job Coach / Trainer
roles.body: Support and grow the Training Track team on the floor. Background in IDD support preferred.

visit.title: Visit
visit.lede: On Wilshire in Santa Monica. Opening July 2026.
body: Street parking, and a lot behind the building.
A short walk from the Metro E Line. Bike racks out front.
The door's the one with the face on it.

notFound.title: Lost your way?
notFound.lede: We couldn't find that page. Let's get you back to something warm.
